name: Felipe Bernardo
title: Leadership Coach & Founder, Servify Studios
quote: At the time of writing, I am on a year-long apprenticeship coaching with Moritz and I must say: there are very few people in my life that have a level of commitment to continuous growth this man has. Moritz is not the same person I knew 11 months ago. Hell, he's not even the same from 1 month ago. I attribute that to what seems like a constant process of getting back to the whiteboard and re-creating himself anew every day. That has an impact on people. It for sure had an impact on me. Besides achieving in 4 months, with his help, most goals I planned to achieve in 1 year, one of my biggest takeaways from our work together was catching on to his ways of being: in integrity with what he says and what he does; highly creative whilst grounded in pragmatism; a true heart-centred leader; an immensely caring and humble husband, friend and mentor; resoundingly truthful to himself and others; a consistent action taker. Meeting with Moritz on a weekly basis for our coaching conversations meant being infected by all of the above, as if to give me permission to be in similar ways in my own life and work. That is a priceless gift. I am blessed. Thank you.
